description: ERP/TMS on-ramp: take a versioned "loadingmcp.packing-list" document (a WMS/ERP export — cargo lines + equipmentCode) and return a load plan + a container manifest. Parsing is fail-explicit: an invalid document returns the exact per-line issues, never a silently-dropped row. Pairs with plan_load's output for a full round-trip.

packingList.description: A loadingmcp.packing-list document: { format: "loadingmcp.packing-list", formatVersion, equipmentCode, jurisdiction?, lines: [...] }. See docs/INTEGRATION.md.

name: import_packing_list
